scope: Evidence-based caveats for downstream confirmatory analysis; not an automatic alteration of frozen fits.

records.evidence: Selected BUSCO copies occupy both sides of an unrooted split observed in all 1000 bootstrap trees: 437 on BRF1-enriched side and 27 on the other side.
required_actions: Reconcile distinct gene copies with supported species phylogeny
Rebuild orthology-consistent marker alignments before interpreting excess structural change
records.limitations: Branch support does not establish function, root placement or duplication timing. Existing unreviewed fits remain descriptive; downstream consumers must explicitly apply this caveat.
